therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with colorectal neoplasms, melanoma, prostatic neoplasms, renal cell carcinoma, and other tumors who previously received tremelimumab in other protocols
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: safety endpoints including serious adverse events, grade 3 or 4 tremelimumab-related adverse events, hypersensitivity reactions, and efficacy endpoints including tumor status and survival

results.effect_size: median disease free survival 3.0 days (95% CI: 2.9–11.8)
safety_signals: grade 3 or 4 tremelimumab-related adverse events in 4/37 patients
results.dose_information: 15 mg/kg IV every 3 months as long as required
